subject: english
question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the segment which contains a spelling error in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

The seizmic zoning displayed/ that the area had been prone/ to many earthquakes.

options.text: that the area had been prone

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the spelling of the word 'seizmic' is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling is 'seismic'.
 
• The word 'seismic' relates to or denotes earthquakes or other vibrations of the earth and its crust.
 
• Therefore, the correct spelling should be used in place of the incorrect form 'seizmic'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *The seismic zoning displayed that the area had been prone to many earthquakes.*
